name: Data analyst
summary: Cleans and joins messy exports, then finds the answer and explains it plainly. Shows the working and says when the data is too thin.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 30 sources, three skills (data profiling and clean-up, insight brief from data, forecast from history), five prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs. Uses the three access levels (read; read and draft; read, write and publish).
Named the UK regulator as the Information Commission, which replaced the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) on 30 Sep 2026 and still uses the ICO name.
